title: The Perfect Confession Again
author: Beatrix Thornbury
blurb: Coral Marchetti, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
